shortDescription: Update Existing VxRail System Proxy settings

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: esrs_passwd
options.description: Password for the Secure Remote Services. If internal SRS is enabled, the password is required.

options.name: proxy_passwd
options.description: The client password for the proxy server.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port number used by the proxy server.

options.name: proxy_user
options.description: The client username for the proxy server.

options.name: server
options.description: The IP address of the proxy server.

options.name: socks_version
options.description: The version of the Socks proxy server. This parameter is only required if the proxy type is SOCKS.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for updating proxy information, the default value is 60 seconds

options.name: type
options.description: Type of proxy server. Supported types are ( "HTTP" ) and ( "SOCKS" ). Must be capitalized.

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
